purpose: Evidence-first rules for populating Vision360 flags without changing requirement-to-flag assignments.
principles: Do not treat missing scanner coverage as a clean NO.
Route scanner evidence into existing flags when semantics match.
Expose newly normalized signals as optional flags for future catalog use.
Preserve traceability through source, rule_id, evidence_count and notes.

has_sca_known_vulnerable_dependencies.change: Returns UNKNOWN when no dependency inventory is available and vulnerability count is zero.

has_sca_critical_vulnerabilities.change: Returns UNKNOWN when absence of critical vulnerabilities is not conclusive due to missing dependency inventory.

has_sca_high_vulnerabilities.change: Returns UNKNOWN when absence of high vulnerabilities is not conclusive due to missing dependency inventory.

has_sca_medium_vulnerabilities.change: Returns UNKNOWN when absence of medium vulnerabilities is not conclusive due to missing dependency inventory.

has_sca_low_vulnerabilities.change: Returns UNKNOWN when absence of low vulnerabilities is not conclusive due to missing dependency inventory.

has_sca_fixable_vulnerabilities.change: Returns UNKNOWN when no dependency inventory is available.

has_sca_unfixed_vulnerabilities.change: Returns UNKNOWN when no dependency inventory is available.

has_sca_license_inventory.source: Trivy license entries and dependency inventory
has_sca_license_inventory.change: Returns UNKNOWN when no dependency or license inventory is available.

fallback_unmapped_flags.source: All flags without a direct detector
fallback_unmapped_flags.change: Unknown by default unless explicitly classified or overridden.

privacy_trackers.source: MobSF trackers.trackers[] and concrete tracker SDK identifiers in source code
privacy_trackers.change: Tracker flags are positive only when MobSF detected_trackers > 0 with concrete tracker entries, or when source code contains concrete known tracker SDK identifiers. total_trackers and appsec.total_trackers are MobSF signature database metadata and are ignored.
privacy_trackers.yes_when: trackers.trackers[] contains entries matching tracker, crash reporting, or analytics categories, or source code contains concrete SDK identifiers such as FirebaseAnalytics, FirebaseCrashlytics, io.sentry, MixpanelAPI, Amplitude, or AppEventsLogger.
privacy_trackers.no_when: MobSF tracker scan is available and detected_trackers == 0, and no concrete tracker SDK identifier is present in source code.
privacy_trackers.na_when: MobSF static report and source code are both unavailable.
